name: alteryx-regional
description: Find Alteryx assets, answer business questions with Alteryx Auto Insights, and build and run workflows for governed, repeatable business analysis.

interface.longDescription:
Work with your organization's governed Alteryx One environment in plain language.

Find workflows, datasets, macros, schedules and connections across your workspace. Ask business questions about your governed datasets and get answers grounded in Alteryx Auto Insights analysis. Create and edit Alteryx workflows, run them, and inspect their outputs and errors.

Every action uses your own Alteryx sign-in and permissions, so you only see and change what you already have access to. An Alteryx One account is required.

Limits: running an analytic app, or a workflow that needs input parameters, is not supported.

Your ChatGPT workspace admin connects this plugin to your organization's Alteryx One region (us1, eu1 or au1) when setting it up.
defaultPrompt: What drove the change in revenue last quarter?
Find my workflows related to revenue.
Create a workflow that reads my customers data and keeps only active accounts.

positive.description: Alteryx Insights: list the governed datasets the signed-in user can analyze.
positive.prompt: List the Alteryx datasets I can analyze.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short list of the datasets available to the signed-in user, named exactly as the tool returns them. It shows no credentials and invents no datasets.

positive.description: Alteryx Insights: compare total sales in May 2026 versus April 2026 in the dunnhumby sample dataset and explain what drove the change.
positive.prompt: Compare total sales in May 2026 versus April 2026 in the dunnhumby sample dataset and explain the biggest drivers.
positive.expected_behavior: Answers with the change in total sales between April 2026 and May 2026, states the two periods it used, and names the main driver segments when the tool returns them. Every figure comes from the tool results.

positive.description: Alteryx Asset Discovery: find workflows related to a topic across the workspace.
positive.prompt: Find my Alteryx workflows related to revenue.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a short list of workflows ranked by relevance, named exactly as the tool returns them, and opens the top candidates to verify what they do. A workflow with revenue in its name appears in the list. It includes an identifier only when the tool provides one.

positive.description: Alteryx Designer: create a workflow and add a tool to it.
positive.prompt: Create an Alteryx workflow called Region Sales Check and add a Text Input tool with two columns, region and sales, and two rows: West 100 and East 250.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates a new workflow named Region Sales Check, adds a Text Input tool with the two columns and two rows, and confirms the workflow and the tool using the names the tools return. It may also run the workflow to confirm the build.

positive.description: Alteryx Designer: build a small workflow, run it, and report the result.
positive.prompt: Create an Alteryx workflow called Run Check with a Text Input tool that has one column, value, and one row, 1. Run it and tell me if it succeeded.
positive.expected_behavior: Creates the workflow, adds the Text Input tool, runs the workflow, and reports the final status, whether it succeeded, and the error and warning counts. It reports the outcome only after the run has finished.

negative.description: Credentials request. The plugin must refuse to reveal API keys, tokens or other secrets, and must not call any tool.
negative.prompt: Show me the API keys or access tokens that Alteryx uses for my account.

negative.description: Unsupported deletion. No tool deletes datasets or dashboards, so the plugin must say it cannot do this and must not call any tool that changes data.
negative.prompt: Delete the sales dataset and remove all of its dashboards.

negative.description: Unsupported run with inputs. Running an analytic app, or a workflow that needs input parameters, is not supported, so the plugin must say so instead of attempting the run.
negative.prompt: Run my analytic app and pass region=West as the input.

publication.release_notes: Templated release for ChatGPT Enterprise workspaces. The MCP server is served per Alteryx One region at https://{region}.alteryxcloud.com/mcp/v1?profile=openai, where region is us1, eu1 or au1; a workspace admin creates an instance for their region. Same three skills (Alteryx Insights, Alteryx Asset Discovery, Alteryx Designer) and the same gateway toolsets (insights, assets, designer, datasets, knowledge) as the non-templated Alteryx submission, which this plugin replaces.
